## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Format documentation is updated when a layout, offset, code, or algorithm changes.
- [ ] A changeset is included for user-visible changes, or the omission is explained below.
- [ ] New fixtures are synthetic or anonymized and contain no personal swimmer data.

## Format evidence

For changes based on observed file behavior, identify the producing software and version and link
to a public specification or describe the anonymized fixture used for verification.

## Changeset omission

Not applicable, or explain why no changeset is required.
